title: Delete dependent records or all local data
description: Explain dependents before individual deletion, apply an explicit deletion policy, and provide confirmed complete removal of application-owned IndexedDB and cache data without claiming downloaded backups are deleted.
acceptanceCriteria: Individual deletion lists dependent record identities/types and the explicit block or cascade policy before confirmation
Cancelled or blocked deletion leaves all durable state unchanged
Confirmed complete deletion removes every application-owned IndexedDB database/store and Cache Storage entry
Complete deletion clearly states it is recoverable only from a user-owned export and cannot delete downloaded backup files
Both confirmation flows default safe, require explicit action, restore focus, and announce results

steps.details: Use the portability registry/reference graph to produce a pure DeletePlan with dependents, explicit block/cascade policy, consequences, and affected counts.
Present the plan before mutation and execute the confirmed policy atomically without dangling references or silent cascading.
After strong explicit confirmation, remove all application-owned IndexedDB and cache data, then return to a clean recoverable shell state.
Test blocked/cascade/cancel/failure paths, complete cleanup, focus/status behavior, offline operation, and copy that downloaded exports remain untouched.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; reuse the portability reference graph and current storage cleanup boundaries.
Deletion owns application storage only; browsers cannot reliably erase arbitrary user downloads.
Do not delete service-worker infrastructure needed to render the clean-state explanation unless the established cache policy requires it.
